title: Experimental Risk Assessment
description: Assesses safety and operational risks for a planned or running experiment: reagents, energy, equipment, and procedural hazards.

steps.prompt: Assess reagent and chemical risks for this experiment. Consider chemical hazards, incompatibilities, PPE requirements, and waste disposal. Rate from 1 (low) to 5 (high) and list mitigations.
Evaluate energy-related risks such as high voltages, high currents, high temperatures, pressurized systems, or laser hazards. Rate from 1 to 5 and provide mitigations.
Assess equipment and instrumentation risks: failure modes, calibration requirements, SOP compliance, and operator training needs. Rate from 1 to 5 with mitigations.
Evaluate procedural risks: complexity of the protocol, potential for human error, contamination risk, and reproducibility concerns. Rate from 1 to 5 with mitigations.
